svg.text: Scale 1.1:1 · md / icon · example at viewport ≥ 768
Dashed outline is opt-in caller class: border.
Header + content share the same width cap.
Media margin adds to the header flex gap.
Action geometry belongs to its own component.
Root is borderless and transparent by default.
No built-in shadow, overlay, or fixed height.
Extra parent height centers the entire stack.
All six parts accept render, asChild, and ref.
Dimensions are source values · slots are schematic
DEFAULT MEDIA: no tile, intrinsic child size [TBD].
ICON MEDIA: Z1 tile, I1 SVG unless size class overrides.
Typography, gaps, and tile sizes inherit from root.
Scale 2:1 · md icon · per-line text slots
MEDIA → TITLE = S4 + S3; TITLE → DESCRIPTION = S3.
Widths drawn for text are schematic; no text-width dimensions.
Time schematic · media → title → description → content
Backwards fill holds each delayed part at opacity 0.
